craft_notes: Sthāyin: grace given and sung back (Vṛtti sphurate kept). Device: comma→dash line 1 (blossoming held), comma→colon line 2 (yielding lands). Rejected: touching the Vṛtti verb — kept exactly as adjudicated. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Hail — by love, for men's release, he blooms, Bhava, thine —
O Keeper, sung and lauded, they yield to Śambhu: bliss in life, in lifelessness.
l4.sanskrit_cite: namo bhaktyā nṛṇāṃ muktyai bhavate bhava te 'vate smṛtyā nutyā ca dadate śambhave śaṃ bhave 'bhave

reads_against.argmap: Bow by devotion, for men's liberation: he blossoms (Vṛtti sphurate, not vocative).; O Bhava (Vṛtti he bhava!), to you (tubhyam), O Protector (rakṣāṃ kurvate) — by remembrance and praise they give to Śambhu: bliss in bhava, in abhava. → He blossoms for liberation; O Bhava, protector, they give remembrance-praise: bliss everywhere.
c1_essence: Milk-sea fortune natural to the Lord alone; the blossomer gives bliss in being and non-being.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with prasāda (grace received and returned)
reads_against.l2: Bow — by devotion, for men's liberation, he blossoms: O Bhava, to you, O Protector — by remembrance and praise they give to Śambhu: bliss in bhava, in non-bhava.
l3: Hail — by love, for men's release, he blooms: Bhava, thine,
O Keeper — sung and lauded, they yield to Śambhu: joy in life, in lifelessness.
reads_against.t1: Bow — by devotion, for liberation of men he blossoms: O Bhava, to you, O Protector — by remembrance and by praise they give to Śambhu: bliss in bhava, in abhava.
